sentences.en: There are a handful of naughty boys in my neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我所在的社区里有几个淘气的小男孩。

sentences.en: There has been another case of cholera in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 这个街区又出现了一例霍乱病例。

sentences.en: Bill boasts of owning the biggest car in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 比尔得意地炫耀自己拥有整个社区里最大的汽车。

senses.zh: 邻里，街坊；附近地区；（数学）邻域；周围环境；大致范围
